notes: The manual calls for female-to-female jumper cables; the catalogue has only a generic `jumper-wire` and a male-to-female one, so the generic `jumper-wire` is used.
Wire end 'a' is at the Pi header and end 'b' is at the PIR pin.
The diagram shows the 5V pin in the top-right of the header, which is 5V.1. It shows the GND pin directly below it, which is GND.1. GP4 is GPIO4.

Wire colours (red, black, orange) are taken from the diagram. The PIR pin order VCC, OUT, GND matches the catalogue port order. The diagram does not label which PIR pin each wire reaches, so this mapping is inferred from the manual's text and the wire colours.
The manual says OUT can go to any numbered GPIO pin. GPIO4 is the one chosen in the example.
